The test image shows a corn leaf with small, scattered tan/white lesions with darker margins. This is a **leaf** disease. Let me compare against top candidates from the 19 leaf classes.

Top candidates based on symptom descriptions: Holcus_Spot, Eyespot, Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight, Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot, Carbonum_Leaf_Spot, Northern_Leaf_Blight, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Gray_Leaf_Spot.

Let me view one reference from each of my top 8 candidates.
Holcus spot reference: single round tan/white spot. The test image has multiple spots that are more elongated. Let me check Eyespot next.
Eyespot: very numerous small circular spots with distinct ring patterns, densely packed. Test image has fewer, more scattered, elongated spots. Not a strong match. Next: Southern Corn Leaf Blight.
Strong visual match! Southern Corn Leaf Blight shows scattered small tan lesions with darker margins, very similar to the test image. Let me continue checking other candidates.
Anthracnose: larger, irregular dark brown lesions along leaf edges with necrotic tissue. Different pattern from test image. Next: Carbonum Leaf Spot.
Carbonum: numerous circular tan/brown spots, more dense and circular than test image. Let me check Northern Leaf Blight.
NLB: large cigar-shaped lesions causing significant leaf damage. Much larger lesions than test image. Next: Gray Leaf Spot.
Gray Leaf Spot: narrow rectangular lesions bounded by veins. More linear than test image. Last view: Physoderma Brown Spot.

Physoderma Brown Spot: numerous very small yellowish spots in bands across the leaf, with dark purplish spots on the midrib. The banding pattern and midrib spots are distinctive but don't match the test image well.

Now let me assess all 8 references against the test image:

- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight** (view 3): Best match. Scattered small tan/white lesions with darker margins on a green leaf, similar size and distribution to test image.
- **Holcus_Spot**: Single round spot, similar color but test image has multiple elongated spots.
- **Eyespot**: Too numerous, too circular with distinct ring pattern.
- **Anthracnose**: Larger, more irregular dark lesions along edges.
- **Carbonum_Leaf_Spot**: More numerous and circular than test image.
- **Northern_Leaf_Blight**: Much larger cigar-shaped lesions.
- **Gray_Leaf_Spot**: Narrow rectangular lesions bounded by veins.
- **Physoderma_Brown_Spot**: Very small spots in distinct bands with midrib involvement.

The test image most closely matches the Southern Corn Leaf Blight reference, showing scattered small to medium tan lesions with darker reddish-brown margins on an otherwise green leaf.
